eventDetail.scope: The conference provides an international forum for researchers to present recent advances in communications, networking, signal processing, electronics, and emerging information technologies. The scope includes communication theory, wireless communications, and machine learning for communication systems. It also covers networking technologies such as ad hoc and sensor networks, optical and satellite communications, and network management. Contributions in signal processing for communications, multimedia, big data, IoT systems, and biomedical applications are also encouraged. Additional topics include antennas and propagation, integrated circuits, embedded and smart electronic systems, as well as microwave and millimeter-wave technologies. Special sessions focus on advanced technologies for 5G-Advanced and 6G wireless systems, and emerging paradigms such as quantum communication and quantum-secure networks.
